jdk: OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.0.5+11-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)
notes: Single-thread local JMH comparison; not a dedicated benchmark machine.
The same benchmark source and prebuilt snapshots are used in both jars.
Only the registry membership collection implementations differ.
comparison_notes: Baseline: ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet() for both registry membership sets.
Candidate: CopyOnWriteArraySet for those same sets; other production code is identical.
Variants ran sequentially: baseline first, then copy-on-write.
JMH runs use one thread, three JVM forks, three 1s warmups, and five 1s measurements.
The benchmark class bytecode hashes match between the two jars.
Optional registration metadata and per-collect snapshot allocation are excluded.
Registry snapshot construction and sorting remain part of the scrape measurement.
Families use names resident_0, resident_1, ... in insertion order; scrape includes sorting.
